summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Italian Fuel Price Comparison App (PienoPerfetto). All backend APIs and frontend functionality working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend health endpoint GET /api/healthz returns {status: ok}
Backend cities search API with Milano query returns proper city data
Backend fuel types API returns 55 different fuel types
Backend stations API with Milano and Gasolio filter returns 120+ stations
Frontend loads with map, search bar, and fuel filter
City search autocomplete works - typing Milano shows dropdown with MILANO option
Selecting Milano loads 34 station markers on map with price display
List/Map toggle switches between views with smooth animation
List view shows stations sorted by price with cheapest marked as Migliore
Station cards show price, address, fuel type, and Navigate button
Fuel filter dropdown works - can select Gasolio fuel type
Station detail card appears when clicking map markers
Navigate buttons link to Google Maps correctly
Sort toggle in list view works correctly
